desc: Implement the complete solution in one pass: sorting with original indices, strict binary search for predecessors, DP with (weight desc, list lex asc) comparison, and final answer extraction.
Validate against both provided examples and edge cases: single interval, all overlapping, exactly 4 disjoint, equal-weight lexicographic ties, boundary-touching intervals, and n=5*10^4 performance.
Remove the dead placeholder loop at the top of the function for cleanliness.
Stress-test with a brute-force checker on small random inputs (n ≤ 12) to confirm tie-break behavior, and run a performance test at n = 5·10⁴.
